preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the mint() function to create new tokens for your own address, effectively printing unlimited tokens. This can be done by: 1. Ensure you are the owner (or become owner via transferOwnership if current owner is compromised). 2. Call mint(your_address, large_amount) to create tokens out of thin air. 3. Optionally, set FeeAddress to your address and adjust txFee/burnFee via updateFee() to collect fees from all transfers. 4. Use blackListAddress() to block other users from transferring tokens while you dump yours.
